Class SwarmViewerApp

java.lang.Object
com.jme3.app.LegacyApplication
com.jme3.app.SimpleApplication
org.swarmforge.client.view.SwarmViewerApp
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jme3.app.Application, com.jme3.system.SystemListener
public class SwarmViewerApp extends com.jme3.app.SimpleApplication
JMonkeyEngine 3D Viewer for SwarmForge. Runs in a separate window/thread from the JavaFX controller. Optimized with Hardware Instancing for mass rendering.
